purpose: bound how long L5's passive interest plausibly stays live, from his own fills against the public book

staleness_s.what: seconds the fill price had been STRICTLY BELOW the best bid when the fill arrived; 0 means it was still at or above the touch

inter_fill_cadence_s_per_token.what: seconds between consecutive L5 fills on the SAME token; a short cadence means his interest on that side is being consumed and re-established continuously

labels: best_bid is a price level in a public book. 'the price was at or above the best bid' says it was at the front of the market, NOT that the order there was L5's.
